entries.msg.player.linux.vmrcURLHelp:
Where <Virtual machine config file> has the syntax:
    vmrc://[<user>|(<ticket-type>:<ticket>)@]<host>[:<port>]/?moid=<VM-id>
    [&httpproxy=<proxy server>[:<proxy port>][&proxyuser=<proxy username>]
    [&proxypasswd=<proxy auth password>]]
or has the syntax:
    vmrc://settings

    example: vmrc://clone:ticket@vsphere-server/?moid=42
    example: vmrc://username@vsphere-server/?moid=79
    example: vmrc://<host>[:port]/?moid=1&httpproxy=<server>&proxyuser=<name>
    exmaple: vmrc://settings

Hints:
    The '&' character in <proxy username> or <proxy auth password>
    should be encoded as '%26'.

The following arguments may be used for MKS connections:
    &websocket=<WebSocket URL>
    &mksticket=<ticket>
    &thumbprint=<SSL thumbprint>
    &path=<VM path>

    example: vmrc://vRAserver/?thumbprint=aa:bb:cc
             &websocket=wss://host:443/ticket/123
